name: CardiacLens v9.10.347.170
notes: v170 moves event awareness into a single color-changing Events tile inside Today's Status. The tile shows whether anything is due, missed, clear, or next; tapping it opens the full event queue. Home-page event cards are removed. Audible sound plays only once when a new event becomes due while the app is open, not when the app is opened.
label: EventsTileQueueSoundTiming
summary: Single Events tile in Today's Status with non-interrupting queue and one-time due-event sound timing.
whatsNew: Today's Status now includes a single Events tile as the gateway to due, missed, and next scheduled events.
The Events tile changes color: green for clear/next, blue for due now, and red for missed.
Large home-page Due & Missed / Next Event cards are removed so the dashboard stays compact.
Tapping Events opens the full queue with Log, Snooze 10, and Dismiss for due or missed items.
Audible sound is state-change based: one soft tone when a new event becomes due while CardiacLens is open; no sound fires just because the app opens.
fixes: Removed event cards that were crowding the mobile home page.
Disabled missed-event catch-up modals from opening automatically on app start.
Advanced service worker cache name for clean GitHub Pages and iPhone refresh.
testing: Verified JavaScript syntax with node --check all.js.
Verified inline script syntax extracted from index.html.
